text: House File 2526 - Introduced HOUSE FILE 2526 BY COMMITTEE ON HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES (SUCCESSOR TO HF 2036) A BILL FOR An Act relating to the confidentiality of the residential 1 addresses of foster parents. 2 BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF IOWA: 3 TLSB 5332HV (2) 91 dg/ko H.F. 2526 Section 1. NEW SECTION . 237D.1 Foster parent addresses —— 1 confidentiality. 2 1. For purposes of this chapter: 3 a. “Address” means the residential address of a person. 4 b. “Child foster care” means the same as defined in section 5 237.1. 6 c. “Department” means the department of health and human 7 services. 8 d. “Foster child” means a child receiving child foster care. 9 e. “Foster parent” means an individual licensee as defined 10 in section 237.1. 11 2. The department and the department’s agents shall 12 not knowingly provide or make available a document to a 13 biological parent of a foster child if the document contains 14 the unredacted address of the foster parent who is currently 15 providing child foster care to the foster child. 16 3. Notwithstanding subsection 2, a document may contain 17 a foster parent’s unredacted address if the foster parent 18 provides written consent to divulge the address to a foster 19 child’s biological parent prior to the department or the 20 department’s agent providing the document or making the 21 document available to the biological parent. 22 EXPLANATION 23 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 24 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 25 This bill relates to the confidentiality of the residential 26 addresses of foster parents. 27 The bill defines “address”, “child foster care”, “foster 28 child”, and “foster parent”. 29 The bill prohibits the department of health and human 30 services (HHS) and HHS’s agents from knowingly providing or 31 making available a document to a biological parent of a foster 32 child if the document contains the unredacted address of the 33 foster parent who is currently providing child foster care to 34 the foster child. 35 -1- LSB 5332HV (2) 91 dg/ko 1/ 2 H.F. 2526 The bill allows HHS and HHS’s agents to provide or make 1 available a document with a foster parent’s unredacted address 2 to a biological parent of a foster child in the foster parent’s 3 care if the foster parent provides prior written consent to 4 divulge the address. 5 -2- LSB 5332HV (2) 91 dg/ko 2/ 2
